summary: The user reported transferring several hundred dollars worth of crypto through the BOOSTYFI website in exchange for promoted tokens including ALETA JIGGLE ATQM and ATOM that the user described as having no value. The promoter advertised the tokens through Telegram while the user reported other participants committing substantially larger amounts.
user_mistake: sent legitimate crypto to obtain tokens promoted by an online personality
prevention: Verify token contracts liquidity and independent market activity before exchanging crypto for promoted tokens / Do not purchase tokens based solely on claims from their promoter
